description:
You are the Release Manager. A critical security fix has been pushed to the branch 'hotfix/login-security-patch' in the 'TailwindTraders-Auth' repository. You must propagate this fix to both the production branch ('main') and the development branch ('develop') using Pull Requests. 

Your instructions:
1. Open the 'TailwindTraders-Auth' repository in Azure DevOps.
2. Create and complete a Pull Request merging 'hotfix/login-security-patch' into 'main'. Title it 'Fix critical login vulnerability'. IMPORTANT: Ensure the source branch is NOT deleted upon completion of this first merge.
3. Create and complete a Pull Request merging 'hotfix/login-security-patch' into 'develop'. Title it 'Sync hotfix to develop'.
4. Once BOTH merges are successfully completed, delete the 'hotfix/login-security-patch' branch manually or via the second PR completion.
5. Verify that the fix exists in both destination branches.

Credentials (if needed): Docker / GymAnything123!
